title: Sony Intervenes to Halt The Last of Us Part 2 Multiplayer Mod
summary: Development on an anticipated multiplayer modification for The Last of Us Part 2 has been abruptly stopped after PlayStation requested the creators to cease their work.

title: Indonesian Ferry Capsizes in Java Sea, Leaving Six Dead and 130 Missing
summary: A ferry traveling between Java and Borneo capsized in severe weather, prompting a large-scale search and rescue operation.

title: Diablo 4 Season 15 Launches Alongside Nintendo Switch 2 Port and Franchise Anniversary
summary: Blizzard is set to launch Diablo 4's 15th season, titled Season of Hell's Legacy, on September 15, 2026. The update coincides with the series' 30th anniversary and brings the action role-playing game to the Nintendo Switch 2.

title: Bali Authorities Investigate Deaths of Australian Man and Two Children
summary: Indonesian police are investigating the deaths of an Australian man and his two children in Bali following a welfare check requested by concerned family members.
